arm_notes.torch: In-process official pipeline (LingbotVLAServer.infer), 12 calls p50 + 3 warmup, robotwin trio obs (3x480x640x3 + 14-dim state + prompt), num_denoising_step=10, use_length=25, bf16 — same protocol as the H100 in-process round. mean 692.8, p90 708.4, load 39.7 s. Loader patched away hardcoded flash_attention_2 (no flash-attn wheel exists for SM110/aarch64): vendored VLM/vision constructed with 'eager' (the vendored class dicts have no sdpa entry; expert config set sdpa but is construction-only). The attention that actually executes in prefill+denoise is upstream's own our_eager_attention_forward einsum (deploy sets attention_implementation='eager'), identical to what the H100 baseline ran; only the vision tower kernel differs (eager vs fa2 on H100). Two latent upstream bugs surfaced because the never-exercised eager-vision path ran: rotate_half() undefined in qwenvl_in_vla.py — fixed with the canonical transformers definition.

arm_notes.protocol: In-process official pipeline (LingbotVLAv2Server.infer, use_length=50, chunk_ret, bf16), reset('robotwin'), 12 calls p50 + 3 warmup, robotwin trio obs — same harness as the H100 round; both arms measured in ONE process (24G checkpoint loads once, 49.5 s).
arm_notes.torch: eager sdpa in-process p50 751.7 ms (mean 755.6, p90 756.1). Loader patched flash_attention_2 -> sdpa (no flash-attn wheel for SM110/aarch64). MoE: BOTH upstream kernels (robby_moe and ops/fused_moe) are Triton and fail with 'PTXAS error: Internal Triton PTX codegen error' for sm_110a, so Qwen2FusedExperts.forward was replaced with a pure-torch dense equivalent of the upstream eager branch (every expert over all tokens, one_hot-combined; identical math, fused weights load unchanged). Both arms run this same MoE, so the ratio is apples-to-apples; absolute torch_ms is somewhat inflated vs a working sparse kernel (32 experts, top-4).
arm_notes.ours: H100 static-capture module (examples/lingbot_vla_v2/static_capture.py, synced unmodified) on Thor torch: p50 477.1 ms (mean 474.2), 138 graph replays across the 15 calls. Gain 1.58x vs 4.45x on H100 — the slow-GPU law: Thor per-kernel time dominates launch overhead, so capture recovers less; the uncaptured prefill (~vision+VLM fill) is also a larger share here. Quality tier from H100: NUMERIC within the model's own run-to-run nondeterminism envelope (fused-MoE atomics; null-control framed); not re-certified on Thor.
arm_notes.compile_arm: As-shipped default (torch.compile) NOT measured on Thor: inductor lowers pointwise fusions through the same Triton backend that fails ptxas for sm_110a, so the as-shipped compile path is not runnable on this device.

walls: Triton-on-sm_110a: ptxas-blackwell internal codegen error kills robby_moe, fused_moe, and (by the same backend) torch.compile. Baseline uses upstream's own eager-branch math over the fused weights (pure torch).

Two latent upstream bugs only reachable on this fallback path: logger undefined in qwen2_action_expert.py except-handler (crashes instead of falling back); _moe_implementation='eager' cannot load the fused checkpoint layout (strict state_dict mismatch).
24G checkpoint over shared WiFi (~7 MB/s aggregate): multi-hour download, required hf_transfer.
Tailnet SSH policy flipped mid-run (guanming refused, root-only); on-box detached jobs were unaffected — results harvested via root+runuser.

L13), fp16-source fp32-math router (F2), stock_bf16 step tables + inv_freq rope (M1 fixes)
engine_arm.denoise_loop_speedup_vs_stock_share: ~5.1x (130.2 ms vs ~670 ms stock denoise share)
engine_arm.protocol: same 12-call p50 + 3 warmup robotwin-trio protocol as the torch/ours arms (bench_vla2.py parity); measured in-process with the stock model (same-process stock e2e 732-783 ms)
engine_arm.quality: M2 gate ladder (iwm_distill/thor_t2v2/m2_gate.json): engine deterministic, CUDA-graph replay BIT-EXACT vs eager (fp16 and fp8 configs), re-prefilled new-frame same-graph case passes; on 9 REAL RoboTwin frames max action delta vs the (deterministic) Thor stock = 0.056-0.078 (2-2.5 bf16-ulp of the action grid; p99 0.026-0.031, inside the stock's own H100-measured 16-draw null on the same inputs = 0.047; cross-hardware stock-vs-stock = 0.031). Strict max-abs gate vs that envelope NOT met — the binding term is the fp16 engine substrate (identical across fp16/fp8 arms), not quantization. Closed-loop non-inferiority = M3.
engine_arm.trap_note: numeric parity must NEVER be read from this protocol's random-pixel obs: they are OOD for the real-frame static fp8 scales (probe 0.5-2.7 there; dynamic-scale control recovers 0.094; real frames 0.074). Latency is unaffected.

engine_full_arm.config: FULL-ENGINE FlashRT vla2 on Thor: engine ViT (fp16, fmha_strided_full) + engine LM prefill (fp16 GEMMs, fwd_bf16_causal attention) + captured fp8 engine denoise loop (batched v0.5 MoE + fp16-source router) — the torch prefill and the 8 ms KV handoff are GONE

notes.official_eager: Isaac-GR00T Gr00tPolicy.get_action, synth_obs from checkpoint modality config (2 cams 256x256 uint8 + eef_9d/gripper/joint state + language), full per-observation pipeline (vision + LLM + DiT + decode every call), sdpa attention (flash-attn not in env), p50 of 15 calls after 3 warmup = 121.9 ms (mean 128.6). H100 reference: 117 -> 70 ms (1.67x)
notes.flashrt_native: the fork's own GrootN17TorchFrontendThor driven directly (tests/test_groot_n17_latency.py pattern): set_prompt(aux) once, then infer(state, fixed noise); CUDA-event p50 of 30 runs = 40.6 ms (mean 40.6), action (1,40,132) finite
notes.ours_engine: InstinctFlash Runtime placement=engine via groot_n17_view + adapter register; same aux bundle and state geometry as the native arm; wall-clock p50 of 20 predicts = 42.4 ms (mean 44.3), action (1,40,132) finite; rt.explain: fused fp8 W+A pipeline, chain tier NUMERIC (uncertified - cosine-level only); Runtime wrapper costs ~1.8 ms vs driving the frontend directly
notes.comparability_caveat: native and engine arms exclude per-request vision BY FRONTEND DESIGN: the vision/LLM prefix is computed once at set_prompt (prompt-scope backbone cache, Phase 3c.b2 aux contract) and per-call infer = state-encode + 4-step DiT + decode. The eager arm reprocesses the full observation every call. 121.9 vs 40.6/42.4 is therefore NOT a like-for-like e2e comparison; the honest engine-vs-fork comparison is 42.4 vs 40.6
notes.aux_bundle: captured fixture-free from the HF policy with forward hooks (S=273 tokens, S_vit=1024, grid_thw 4 entries); MISSING_KEYS=['input_ids'] - the Qwen3VL path passes inputs_embeds without input_ids, and set_prompt does not consume input_ids, so both downstream arms ran and produced finite actions
notes.gated_backbone: gr00t loads the full Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration from gated nvidia/Cosmos-Reason2-2B at policy init; pre-seeded into the HF cache with the box token (access verified) after the first eager attempt failed for lack of HF_TOKEN in the chain env
